The trailing owner correction governs copied clip occurrences, retained origin association, grouped assembly trim and bounded Ungroup, and library-only named-clip updates. Superseded model tombstones are excluded from active realization. Existing researched patterns retain prior parent source-checked evidence; no new external pattern claim is made. openQuestions.question: Where should Ungroup place included parts whose simultaneous timing cannot be represented on the destination track without overlap?
openQuestions.why: Saved clips can contain a four-track composition, while timeline clips on one track cannot overlap. The current source defines which trimmed parts survive but does not define a track-placement policy for overlapping parts. Keep the copied group and draft intact; do not infer flattening, shifts or alternate track mapping. openQuestions.question: How should Ungroup transfer a group's nondefault source rectangle, volume or mute to its included parts?
openQuestions.why: Group-level crop and audio adjustments can change the picture or sound even when parts are sequential. Their disposition on Ungroup is not specified. Until a transfer policy is selected, a group with a non-full-frame source rectangle, volume other than 100%, or mute enabled cannot be ungrouped; explain the applicable adjustment and retain the complete copied group, draft and selection. The supported neutral-group path retains each part's own framing and audio settings without resetting them.
